name: Torchlit Blocktale captions

font.measured: x-height 48 px and full box 84 px including the outline (y 1267-1351); Poppins Bold 72 px gives x-height 40 + 8 px of outline = 48 and a box of 78 + 8 = 86

position.note: x-centre measured 540 (0.498 of width); glyph box y 1267-1351 = 69% of height. The daylight video sat about 50 px lower; keep 1330 for all moods

case: lowercase as spoken; capitalise names, 'I' and onomatopoeia ('Dong'); numbers as digits ('300', '11:20')
punctuation: drop commas and full stops; keep apostrophes ('don't', 'you're')
keyword_color_rules: none: every word is white (the source never colours key words); emphasis comes from the picture and the cut

animation.hold: until the next word's onset (no gap, no fade)
animation.out: hard cut to the next word
animation.measured: word-to-word hold median 0.30 s, 90th percentile 0.50 s; a scale pop is visible on about 1 word in 3 at 10 fps sampling, so it lasts 1-2 frames

timing.show_at: word start from *-word-timings.json, rounded DOWN to the frame
timing.hide_at: next word start (last word holds to the end of the video)
timing.offset_vs_cut: 0 frames: cuts are placed on word onsets (cut_plan), so the caption change and the cut land on the same frame 85%+ of the time

multi_word_exceptions: numbers and times stay one token ('11:20'); hyphenated words stay one token

handle.note: ours (Studio Bible), not in the source

extras.sticker_overlays: 2D stickers ('Z z z', music notes) are picture elements, not captions: stepped at 10 fps, drifting up 40-60 px/s

ass_equivalent.note: alignment 2 (bottom centre); MarginV 570 = 1920 - 1350, the measured bottom of the glyph box incl. descenders and outline, which puts the baseline at about y 1330
